name: bartholomew-arp-gateway
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) in-process safety and trajectory execution firewall for autonomous agents.

tools.name: btp_audit_trajectory
tools.description: Evaluates raw agent tool calls and step trajectory in sub-35 microseconds against OWASP LLM Top 10 invariants.

tools.name: btp_scrub_credentials
tools.description: Scrubs high-entropy API secrets (sk-proj, ghp_, AWS keys) from agent thought streams and arguments.

tools.name: btp_sign_step_receipt
tools.description: Generates a FIPS 186-5 Ed25519 signature over RFC 8785 canonical JSON trajectory proof.
